faq.q: How do I crop or reposition a photo inside a cell?
faq.a: Build the collage, then in the live preview click a cell to assign or swap its image (clicking the already-selected cell cycles to the next uploaded photo), drag inside a cell to pan, and scroll to zoom from 0.5× up to 5×. Images are fitted to fill each cell while keeping their aspect ratio, so you control exactly what's visible and cropped.

faq.q: What layouts and output sizes are there?
faq.a: Layouts are 2×2, 3×3, 1+2 (one large plus two small), 2×1 side-by-side, 1×2 stacked, 3-strip horizontal, 3-strip vertical, and a Freeform grid that sizes itself to your number of photos. Output presets cover Instagram square 1080×1080, portrait 1080×1350, story 1080×1920, Facebook 1200×630, YouTube thumbnail 1280×720, plus custom dimensions.

faq.q: Can I control the gaps, borders and background?
faq.a: Yes — sliders for gap (0–60px), outer padding (0–60px) and corner radius (0–50px), plus a solid background colour or a two-colour gradient. You can add a caption with chosen size, colour and position (top, centre or bottom). These settings are saved in your browser so your look carries over between collages.

faq.q: How do I download it, and what if an image won't load?
faq.a: Download as PNG or JPG (with a quality slider and estimated file size shown) or copy the collage straight to the clipboard as PNG. If some uploaded files can't be read, those are skipped with a warning and the rest are kept and stay aligned to the correct cells; if none can be read you're told to try PNG, JPG or WEBP.
